title: When Routine Operations Break Architectural Pattern Relationships in LLM Agent Harnesses
title_zh: 当常规操作破坏LLM智能体执行框架中的架构模式关系时

paragraphs.en: 研究发现LLM智能体框架的常规操作会悄然破坏架构模式关系，导致安全防护失效，需针对部署路径进行评估。 LLM agent harnesses distribute tool mediation, state management and safety guardrails across native services, independently written plugins and configuration. Routine operations can change the runtime order or retained state that architectural pattern relationships require, without any code change. We study five relationships associated with the Guardrail Enforcement Point, Autonomy Controller and Blackboard patterns across five released harnesses, analysing a main sample of fourteen independently written plugins. Using PatternOps, our assessment procedure, we trace requirements from pattern descriptions, provider documentation and deployment profiles to the providers that realise them and the records that decide them. We then compare alternative allocations under supported operations. Such operations broke relationships silently: after a plugin was reapplied or an allow rule saved, policy stopped evaluating edits while every plugin stayed active, and a prohibited edit executed. Which alternatives qualified depended on the requirement. Allocations that kept the required order, or kept or rebuilt the needed state, held on their tested paths and operation sequences, while others prevented prohibited effects but missed edits rejected elsewhere. In these harnesses, a pattern relationship is a property of the running system and its history, so architects should evaluate it against the decision paths, state lifetimes and operation sequences their deployments use.
paragraphs.zh: 研究发现，LLM 智能体框架的常规操作会悄然破坏架构模式关系，导致安全防护失效，因此需要针对部署路径进行评估。LLM 智能体框架将工具中介、状态管理与安全护栏分散到原生服务、独立编写的插件和配置之中。 常规操作可以在不改动任何代码的情况下，改变架构模式关系所要求的运行时顺序或保留的状态。 我们研究了五个已发布框架中与护栏执行点、自主控制器和黑板模式相关的五种关系，分析了由十四个独立编写插件组成的主样本。 借助我们的评估流程 PatternOps，我们从模式描述、提供商文档和部署配置出发，追踪各项需求直至实现它们的提供商以及判定它们的记录。 随后，我们在受支持的操作下比较不同的分配方案。 此类操作会悄无声息地破坏关系：在插件被重新应用或允许规则被保存后，策略不再对编辑进行评估，而所有插件仍保持活跃，最终一个被禁止的编辑得以执行。 哪些替代方案合格取决于具体需求。 保持所需顺序、或保留并重建所需状态的分配方案，在其经过测试的路径和操作序列上依然有效；而其他方案虽能阻止被禁止的效果，却会遗漏在其他地方被拒绝的编辑。 在这些框架中，模式关系是运行系统及其历史的一种属性，因此架构师应当依据其部署所使用的决策路径、状态生命周期和操作序列来评估它。
